abstract: Deloitte's 2026 Global Insurance Outlook (October 9, 2025) highlights a workforce-transformation gap: 90% of insurance executives recognize the urgency of reinventing the employee value proposition for human-machine collaboration, but only 25% have taken tangible action. The outlook frames agentic AI as reshaping the next stage of insurance work — Allianz, AXA, and AIG are cited exploring agentic claims processing.
keyFindings: 90% of insurance execs see urgency to reinvent work for human-machine collaboration
Only 25% have taken tangible action to elevate human skills — 65pp gap between recognition and action
Agentic AI shaping next stage of insurance development; carriers like Allianz, AXA, AIG cited
Industry shifting from 'What can AI do?' to 'How do we make AI work at scale?'
Many European carriers still focused on data modernization and cloud migration as prerequisites
methodology: Deloitte Human Capital survey of insurance executives combined with practitioner interviews across major carriers.
qualifiers: Deloitte is a consulting firm with commercial interest in workforce-transformation projects. Survey population is executive-level and likely skews toward large multinational carriers. Recognition-vs-action gap is a common consulting narrative structure.
